notes.ai_difficulty: expected MAC-equivalents per AI block, independent of the tile shape a miner picked
notes.block_reward_nock: already the 80% miner share; an AI block and a ZK block pay a miner identically
notes.block_times: ZK 500 s and AI 214 s ideal intervals since Anthropos (~30% ZK / ~70% AI blocks, ~150 s combined)
notes.difficulty: expected attempts per ZK block; since height 147,500 (Anthropos, ZK proof %5) one attempt is one Tip5 hash of proof object 0, and a full proof is built only for a winning nonce
excludes: electricity: no power draw is modelled, because we have no measured wattage for any machine on these boards
pool fees, and the variance a solo miner at these rates actually faces (a fraction of a block per day is not a block per day)
difficulty drift: every figure is a snapshot at the observed-at times above, and difficulty moves as hashrate joins or leaves
price drift: the same snapshot caveat, on a spot price that can move further in an hour than difficulty does in a week
notes.ranked_input: board estimates are computed from the ranked, server-measured rate (verified_zk_hashes_per_sec_lb, verified_mac_per_sec_lb), never a client-reported one
notes.zk_board: ZK v5 rows (rules anthropos) are verified Tip5 hashes/s, the unit difficulty counts since height 147,500, and are priced from that ranked rate; pre-anthropos rows are complete %3 proofs/sec, which does not price, so they carry no estimate
